title: Attach not accepted by the network

entities.name: ATTACH REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE when attach request cannot be accepted, containing EMM cause value.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating reason for attach rejection with specific cause values.

entities.name: Extended EMM cause IE
entities.description: Additional cause information element providing extended rejection details.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Back-off timer assigned by network for congestion control during attach rejection.

entities.name: Timer T3410
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receiving integrity protected ATTACH REJECT message.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state entered by UE after attach rejection with various substates.

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s) for roaming
entities.description: IE containing tracking areas forbidden for roaming, stored by UE upon attach rejection.

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s) for regional provision of service
entities.description: IE containing tracking areas forbidden for regional service, stored by UE upon attach rejection.

entities.name: T3346 value IE
entities.description: Information element containing timer value for T3346 in ATTACH REJECT message.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to attach to network, which may be rejected.

entities.name: Integrity protection condition
entities.description: Condition checking if message is integrity protected, affecting UE behavior.

entities.name: EMM cause #25 condition
entities.description: Special condition for EMM cause #25 requiring integrity protection check.

relations.description: ATTACH REJECT message contains EMM cause IE indicating rejection reason.
ATTACH REJECT message may contain Extended EMM cause IE for additional details.
ATTACH REJECT message may contain T3346 value IE for back-off timer assignment.
ATTACH REJECT message may contain forbidden TAI(s) for roaming IE.
ATTACH REJECT message may contain forbidden TAI(s) for regional service IE.
Receiving integrity protected ATTACH REJECT message stops timer T3410.
ATTACH REJECT message with T3346 value IE starts timer T3346.
ATTACH REJECT message causes UE to enter EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
EMM cause #25 requires integrity protection check for ATTACH REJECT message.
Integrity protection condition determines how T3346 timer value is set.
Attach procedure includes network sending ATTACH REJECT message when not accepted.
